0.original: Ameexia of Little Solace is again in need of an adventurer's aid.

1.original: Ameexia has lost her precious thread and is unable to do her weaving. Travel to the Bramble Patch and retrieve the three missing spindles.

2.original: You have successfully recovered Ameexia's lost spindles of cloud silk. Return them to their owner.

3.original: At long last able to return to her weaving, Ameexia expresses her profuse gratitude for your aid.

25.original: Deliver the cloud silk to Ameexia at Little Solace.

48.original: Helpful one has returned! This one is troubled. When this one ran away from nasty tusked ones, this one dropped three spindles of thread!

49.original: This one searched brambly place over and over, but nothing was found! Oh, woe is this one! Helpful one will help, yes?

51.original: Without thread, this one cannot weave! Whatever is this one to do?

52.original: This one's thread! This one can weave again! Helpful one is so kind. This one thanks helpful one from bottom of this one's heart!
